provenance.classification: locally authored prototype inspired by Alfresco Community Edition; not a verified upstream fork or official Alfresco distribution
verification_basis: local Git remote and commit history
absence of a checked-in LICENSE, NOTICE, or COPYING file

governance.update_strategy: frozen until an owner, license decision, and extraction plan are approved

restrictions: Do not deploy, publish, sell, or represent this snapshot as Alfresco software.
Do not rely on legacy feature, certification, compliance, performance, uptime, or support claims.
Do not run bundled launch, stop, seed, reset, Docker, or Kubernetes automation on shared systems.
Do not copy code into a product until provenance, third-party licenses, trademarks, dependencies, and credentials are reviewed.
activation_requirements: Assign a named accountable owner and security-patching owner.
Resolve repository and third-party licensing and trademark use in writing.
Select a supported journey and extract it into a separate product boundary.
Define identity, data, provider, configuration, migration, backup, and release contracts.
Replace demo credentials and destructive automation and pass risk-based acceptance tests.
